angle: Data-driven property investment strategy for high returns
body_text:
Here’s how we made $1.3m in 4 years… with a strategy anyone can use

When we got married, we had no BTO grants, no EC eligibility — just stable incomes and a lot of questions.

We had to choose: stay comfortable in HDB, or take a calculated leap into private property.
 
So we studied the data. 

The right data.

That gave us the confidence to buy a $1.7M resale 3-bedder — and later, a $2.3M new launch.

Fast forward 4 years:

 ✅ sold both properties at the 3-year mark with over 10% annualized gains 

 ✅ made $1.3M in net profits

 ✅ and now we own a landed and condo portfolio worth $6M+

This was not just about luck or timing. 

It was about making calculated moves towards a solid exit plan. 

So What’s our secret?

We call it Understanding Fundamentals — and it’s built on 4 pillars:

1️⃣ Not all properties grow the same. Demand is not homogenous. We looked where demand was strong, but supply was tight.

2️⃣ We identified who actually moves the market — like resale upgraders post-MOP, not just investors.

3️⃣ We reverse-engineered BTO & MOP data to predict future demand spikes.

4️⃣ And we used the QPE Framework to pick the right property type for our goals.

Most people chase showflats and hype.
 
We chased opportunities in areas with price gaps and planned our exit from Day 1.

Because strong profits? It’s made where no one’s looking. Just like how we did it.

So where do opportunities lie this year?

We’ve found a sweet spot in a segment of the property market, one that many buyers may overlook.

It’s got a solid price gap and huge upside potential 

Speak to us for a 1-1 sharing to learn more. 

📘 We’ve put all our strategies into a cheatsheet to show you:

 ✅ How to find undervalued properties

 ✅ How to use MOP/BTO data to your advantage

 ✅ The 3 developments with strong upside this year 

 ✅ How to plan a strong exit before you even buy

Click on ‘Learn More’ and we’ll send it over to you.
